required_scopes: Read-only access to public MDBList lists

intro.title: Connect MDBList
intro.summary: Lets you turn a public MDBList list into a collection. Only the list's address and your key go to MDBList.

steps.title: Account
steps.description: Sign in to MDBList or create a free account.
instructions: Open your MDBList preferences and find the API section.

steps.title: Get credential
steps.description: Copy the free API key shown in your MDBList preferences.

steps.title: Connect
steps.description: Library will perform a read-only connection check.

troubleshooting.title: MDBList did not accept this key
troubleshooting.message: Copy the API key again from your MDBList preferences.
instructions: Make sure you are signed in to the account that owns the key.

troubleshooting.title: MDBList rate limit reached
troubleshooting.message: MDBList limits how often a free key can ask. Wait before trying again.

troubleshooting.title: MDBList is temporarily unavailable
troubleshooting.message: Your key may be valid. Try again later.

troubleshooting.title: Library could not reach MDBList
troubleshooting.message: Check this server's internet, DNS, proxy, and firewall settings.

skip_consequences.summary: MDBList list addresses cannot be turned into collections. Other list sources and list files still work.

credentials.label: MDBList API Key
credentials.format_hint: The API key shown in your MDBList preferences.

declaration.changelog: First built-in version: public MDBList lists as collections.
